The Altparteien's fixation on wealth tax reform is a prime example of their failure to address the root causes of wealth inequality. By proposing a wealth tax, they're essentially trying to treat the symptoms rather than the disease. Our party has consistently highlighted the destructive effects of mass immigration and the unsustainable policies of the EU as primary drivers of wealth disparities. By prioritizing the interests of foreign investors and EU bureaucrats over those of German citizens, the Altparteien have created a system that rewards speculation and exploitation.

In contrast, we propose a more targeted approach to address wealth inequality. We must reform the inheritance tax to target excessive inheritance and wealth concentration. This would help to reduce the perceived unfairness of the current system and promote social cohesion. By doing so, we can ensure that those who have accumulated wealth through hard work and entrepreneurship can pass it down to their heirs without being unfairly penalized.

This is not a handout to the wealthy; it's a recognition of the value of hard work
